description.value:
Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 115. Category: feat. Trained Feature Feats.

Requires Egostitical Strength
When you would spend Destruction Die, your
destruction burns with even more vigor and adds it to
the power of your Destruction. When you would use
Fighting Spirit, you gain an additional amount of
temporary hit points or temporay ki points equal to half
your level. When you would use Destroy, you deal an
additional damage equal to half your level. When you
would use Neverending Destruction, you gain additional
temporary stamina equal to half your level. You may
pick this feat multiple times, when you do, you choose
which feature to add your full level instead of half level.
